notes.title: Cubot trading card are there!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.nicoplv.com/uploads/media/default/0001/01/c3bbdaddb00b1df5f99b97ba642604a6ba864b38.png[/img]

You can now collect Steam Trading Cards by playing Cubot ;)

And version 1.5.1 of Cubot is available:
- Added windowed mode
- Added resolution choice
- Added controller choice menu
- Fixed some bugs
